## Summary
A clear, one-paragraph description of the request.

## Motivation
Why is this needed / who benefits?

## Proposed behavior
- [ ] Acceptance criterion 1
- [ ] Acceptance criterion 2

## Scope
What is explicitly out of scope for this request (so it doesn't interrupt the
active build phases)?

## References
Relevant files, docs, or existing issues.

## Notes
- Is this a spike/prototype (keep default behavior unchanged)? Add the `spike`
  label.
- Check that this doesn't overlap an open issue (list issues with
  `gh issue list --state open`).
